description: This file defines a React component named `TopRecommendations`, which displays the top 3 high-priority recommendations fetched from services and fake data. It includes styles, state management, and rendering logic for different UI states like loading, error, empty, and populated states. The component interacts with external services for data retrieval and handles user interactions such as fixing recommendations and viewing details.
